\section[der Knoblauch]{der Knoblauch — garlic}

\label{lesson:GE-C122-knoblauch}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the German for a cherry, then the German for a melon.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: der Knoblauch}
\textbf{der Knoblauch} — \textquotedblleft{}garlic\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{Knoblauch} $\leftarrow$ Middle High German \emph{knobelouch} (EtymDB 2.1), older \emph{klobelouch}, \textquotedblleft{}split leek\textquotedblright{} for its cloves: the \textquotedblleft{}leek\textquotedblright{} word $\leftarrow$ Proto-Germanic \emph{*laukaz}, English \emph{leek}.
\end{cousinweb}
